description: Deterministic daily book pick from the indexed corpus, date-seeded so every caller gets the same answer on the same UTC day. Optional date override for backfill. Costs $0.001 via x402 (requires WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, USDC on Base).

date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to replay a past day's pick
